instructions: If your raid DPS is very low, worm adds (Shadowlurkers) will spawn around the area before the cloud phase. Hitting them once or twice causes them to disappear. If they are left alive for too long, they will target random players with a massive AoE (Black Thunder) that deals damage and inflicts a stack of Vulnerability Up.
Cloud of Darkness targets the tank with a powerful auto-attack that also deals damage over time, so keep your tank safe.
